slots.ev: 房間裡試那雙長靴，牆上還掛著那張車的海報
slots.pl: 她房間的床邊，牆上掛著一張她那台車的海報，只有床頭一盞燈
slots.pl_en: on the edge of the bed in her room, a poster of her own model of car pinned on the wall behind, one bedside lamp on
slots.wall_ok: 牆上那張車的海報是場景的一部分，守則不得禁止它
slots.ac: 她坐在床沿把長靴的拉鍊拉到底，一手扶著小腿
slots.ac_en: She is sitting on the edge of the bed pulling the boot zip all the way up, one hand around her calf.
slots.ac_s: 私下核心：房間裡的貼身短版與長靴
slots.of: 黑色貼身短版上衣配短裙，長靴到膝上
slots.of_en: a black fitted cropped top with a short skirt and boots over the knee
slots.of_s: 私下核心：貼身短版與長靴／色盤：黑
slots.li: 床頭那盞暖燈在她正前方，房間其餘部分全暗，對比很高
slots.li_en: The warm bedside lamp is directly in front of her, the rest of the room completely dark, and the contrast is high.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「高對比、金屬質感、夜間為主」
slots.fa: 很直接地看著鏡頭，沒有笑
slots.fa_en: Looking very directly at the lens without smiling.
slots.hair_en: down, the silver-grey strands catching the lamp

slots.ev: 週末的車聚，她從高中就跟著跑

ppl.act: 圍在別的車旁邊講話、蹲下來看輪圈
ppl.wear: 車聚會穿的 T 恤、短褲、球鞋，有人戴著帽子

slots.pl: 吉隆坡郊區一場週末車聚的停車場，白天，一排改裝車停在那裡
slots.pl_en: in the car park of a weekend car meet outside Kuala Lumpur in the daytime, a row of modified cars parked up
slots.ac: 她靠在自己那台車的側面，兩手都空著
slots.ac_en: She is leaning against the side of her own car with both hands empty.
slots.ac_s: 誰是她：從高中就跟著哥哥們跑車聚
slots.of: 黑色短版背心配寬版工作褲
slots.of_en: a black cropped vest with wide work trousers
slots.li: 太陽在車陣那一側、在她背後，車漆把光反回鏡頭，她自己這一面暗一階
slots.li_en: The sun is behind her over the line of cars, the paintwork throws it back towards the lens, and her own side sits a stop darker.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「保留反光」——白天用車漆的反光，不是濕地面
slots.fa: 很自在，看著另一台車那邊
slots.fa_en: Completely at ease, looking over towards one of the other cars.
slots.fa_s: 性格：她懂車，不是被放在車旁邊的擺設

slots.ev: 夜衝停在那間固定的加油站，人還坐在駕駛座上
slots.pl: 她那台車的駕駛座上，停在夜衝固定會停的那間加油站
slots.pl_en: in the driver's seat of her own car, pulled in at the petrol station she always stops at on a night run
slots.ac: 她一手還搭在排檔上，身體轉向副駕那一側
slots.ac_en: One hand is still on the gear lever and she has turned towards the passenger side.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：夜衝一定會在同一間加油站停／副駕永遠放著一條擦車布
slots.of: 黑色貼身長袖配皮質短褲
slots.of_en: a black fitted long-sleeve top with leather shorts
slots.li: 加油站的冷白頂燈從擋風玻璃外面進來，車內儀表板是琥珀色的
slots.li_en: The station's cool white canopy lighting comes in through the windscreen while the dashboard inside glows amber.
slots.li_s: 氛圍原句：「車庫冷白日光燈、車燈紅黃…高對比、金屬感、夜間為主」
slots.fa: 沒有笑，看著副駕那一側
slots.fa_en: Not smiling, looking across to the passenger side.

slots.ev: 回家前在車庫停一下，引擎蓋開著，她沒打算現在弄
slots.pl: 她家的車庫，夜裡，一盞工作燈打在打開的引擎蓋上
slots.pl_en: in her own garage at night, a work lamp trained on the propped-open bonnet
slots.ac: 她靠在車尾，手上拿著那條擦車布，沒有要動手的意思
slots.ac_en: She is leaning on the back of the car holding the cloth, with no intention of starting anything.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：副駕永遠放著一條擦車布／指甲留短，因為要碰車
slots.of: 灰色寬版連身工作服，上半身脫下來綁在腰上，裡面是黑色短版背心
slots.of_en: grey overalls with the top half peeled down and tied at her waist over a black cropped vest
slots.li: 工作燈從她側前方打過來，車庫深處全暗，金屬反光很強
slots.li_en: The work lamp reaches her from the side and in front, the back of the garage is completely dark, and the metal throws hard reflections.
slots.li_s: 後製原句：「高對比、金屬質感」
slots.fa: 低頭看著手上的布，有點懶得動
slots.fa_en: Looking down at the cloth in her hand, not really inclined to move.
slots.hair_en: tied up out of the way

slots.ev: 白天出門前挑鞋，指甲還是留得很短
slots.pl: 她房間的鞋櫃前，白天，幾雙鞋已經被拿出來排在地上
slots.pl_en: at the shoe rack in her room in the daytime, several pairs already pulled out and lined up on the floor
slots.ac: 她蹲在地上兩手拿著一隻鞋在看鞋底
slots.ac_en: She is crouched on the floor turning one shoe over in both hands to look at the sole.
slots.ac_s: 小習慣：指甲留短，因為要碰車
slots.of: 琥珀黃色的短版針織配牛仔短褲
slots.of_en: an amber-yellow cropped knit with denim shorts
slots.li: 白天的窗光從側面進來，鞋櫃內側暗
slots.li_en: Daylight comes in from the side and it stays dark inside the rack.
slots.li_s: 後製：白天的私下場景不套用夜間高對比
slots.fa_en: Concentrating, not looking at the lens.
slots.fa_s: 語氣：講到車會突然變得很專業
